description: Record that you looked for the expected signal (POST /actions/{id}/signal-checks). not_found_in_source REQUIRES source and period: it says where you looked and when, never that a third party did not answer. found closes nothing; link the signal with forbiz_record_signal. cannot_check REQUIRES reason.

source.description: Where you looked, e.g. { kind: 'email_thread', detail: 'Re: quote' }

name: forbiz_check_signal
title: Record a signal check
